description: List the direct user members of one Origin review or ownership group visible to the caller for a repository. Pass the group's grp_… id or qualified @organization/group login. Members page by stable public user_… login, with the display name the portal can show or the login as fallback.

group.description: Visible review group as a grp_… id or qualified @organization/group login

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.
